notes.title: Patch 1.1.9 - New confirmation system to buy raw materials + bugfixes
notes.notes:
We noticed that some of you reported that the buying of raw materials on the reproducer wasn't ideal because you could too easily buy the wrong one. To prevent this, we added a small confirmation system which should help resolve this inconvenience.
Now when you press one of the buying buttons, the pressed button icon will blink for 3 seconds and you will have to press the button again to actually buy the material. If you don't press it during the 3 seconds or press another button it will start the procedure again. And this simple system is still allowing to buy quickly by pressing the button 2 times in a row.
We hope it will improve your experience!
We also fixed a few bugs and descriptions that were wrong.

Here is the content of the patch:

- Bugfix: the floor height was still problematic in the gearbox maintenance station
- Bugfix: If your spaceship was too close to a system (less than 1s) the hyperdrive couldn't be engaged
- Bugfix: Unlocks not saved were keeped when reloading a savegame without exiting the game
- Bugfix: some parts were not properly reloaded if saved partly disassembled
- Bugfix: If you pointed your finger during screwing the screwdriver/screwgun was falling from the hand

- Fix: The visual effect of the weather probe launching wasn't working.
- Fix: The sector blueprint was misplaced a little bit inside the workbench
- Fix: RPM textures of the camshafts were inverted
- Fix: The descriptions of the recycling was wrong. The more a part is used the less you can salvage its row materials and the more a part is new the less it will yield experience points.
- Fix: The description of the fixit tool was mentionning all 'parts' whereas it only works on damaged housings.

- Improvement: new confirmation system when buying raw materials on the reproducer
- Improvement: when using fuel on a probe the priority is given to the most consumed cell instead of a fixed arbitrary order

Have a good game!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.8 - Locked hands bug + other bugfixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We finally found the source of the locked hands bug!
It was a difficult one to fix because it was only happening when you completed the tutorial then started a new game without exiting the game...
We also fixed some other bugs that you reported on the forums.
We want to thank all of you who are taking the time to report a bug or suggest new improvements.
Please keep doing that, it really is helping us!

- Bugfix: locked hands sometimes when warping to a blue star
- Bugfix: sometimes the game starts in seated mode
- Bugfix: the wave amplifier "explorer class" didn't fit in it's housing
- Bugfix: Translation error for the CIG control panel (previously electrical box)
- Bugfix: the floor was too high in the drilling maintenance station
- Bugfix: when you reach the final destination you can't turn back on the oxygen if it was previously turned off
- improvement: the destock time has been lowered from 7 seconds to 3 seconds

We hope these fixes will improve your experience and as usual, don't hesitate to report a bug in the forum.

Have a good game!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.7 - Oculus 180° tracking support with comfort mode + bugfix
notes.notes:
Dear community,

We just pushed a new update to improve the support of 180° tracking setups.
Now you can use the thumbsticks on the Oculus Touch (or the trackpad on the Vive) to turn 90 degrees instantly (usually called "comfort mode").

This new option is activated by default for Oculus users but any player can switch it in the menus.

Thanks to wolfox79 for the suggestion!

We also fixed a bug with the camshafts. When installing improved versions the drilling was slower when it should have been quickier.

Thanks to Inferno for reporting the bug!

Have a good game!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.6 - Oculus Touch and tutorial big update
notes.notes:
Dear community,

As a result of the many negative feedbacks we have received on Oculus Touch's support, we decided to add a feature that makes it possible to improve the grasping of distant objects on the ground to avoid losses of tracking.

This option is activated by default for all Touch users. You only have to look at the object and reach out for it with your hand in its direction. The object will then come to you as if by magic.

Vive users will be able to activate the option in the menus if they wish.

We want to remind Oculus Rift users that Far Beyond: A space odyssey is a roomscale game that requires at least a 1.5mx2m play area.
As stated in Oculus recommendations, for this type of experiment we advocate the use of a third camera in order to have the most enjoyable experience possible.

About the tutorial, we also added a system that will allow you to skip the interventions of the robot.
You can simply press the two triggers of your motion controllers to skip a sequence.

We hope that these two features will improve your gaming experience.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.5 - Oculus Rift + Touch are now supported!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We are happy to announce that Far Beyond: A space odyssey is now compatible with Oculus Rift and supports Oculus Touch controllers!
We know that we are a little bit in advance (the official Touch launch is on December 6) but we were eager to share our game with this new community.

One more thing, we fixed a bug discovered by Casual_002 when you cannot screw DBEs when you install them separatly. Now the floor is a little lower so that you can easily access the screw.

Have a good game!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.4 - Various Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, we just pushed a stability update:

- Bugfix: D.B.E. are inverted in the reproducer
- Bugfix: Wave amplifiers have the same specs in the reproducer
- Bugfix: Some parts can be unlocked without sufficient RP
- Bugfix: In some cases the gearbox cannot be recycled
- Bugfix: It's possible to plug a fuel cell on the Fixit tool while it's on the toolrest
- Bugfix: When the Fixit tool goes out of reach the fuel cell is not restocked
- Bugfix: Storms on planets were not correctly disabled (it was initially a feature but we found it too hardcore)
- Bugfix: Statistics about the number of storms were incorrect
- Bugfix: In some cases the fuel cell plugged to the fixit tool cannot be grabbed
- New security to ensure the storm alarm is stopped when leaving a system
- New sound for the oxygen alarm (it was the same as the storm alarm)
- Framerate optimizations

Big thanks to everyone who are reporting the bugs they found (particurarly Tesserex, Casual_002 and [BE]Crowind). It's really helping us!
We weren't able to reproduce all the bugs, but hopefully they will be gone after theses fixes. If you're still experiencing a bug don't hesitate to report it on the forums (if possible with the details on how reproduce it).

Have a good game!

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 - Difficulty improvement / Customizable game mode / New tool ! Now available
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26635722/a23576ff61f915d4662f38d7cd1d3841673b488b.png[/img]

[b]Hello everyone[/b],

We are happy to release our first big update.
This patch has the vocation of making our favorite rogue-like more accessible while keeping that hardcore side we love so much. In addition, we have added a new tool that will really change your space maintenance routine.

So here's what this patch is about:

[b]A difficulty on-demand[/b]

- Improvements of the global balancing for each difficulty mode.
- New [b]menu to customize any new game[/b] (displayed after choosing the initial difficulty).
- New option to [b]automatically recharge the spaceship's fuel in rest systems[/b].
- New option to [b]remove storms in rest systems[/b].
- New option to manage storms frequency.
- New option to manage planets resources richness.
- New option to manage battery autonomy.
- New option to manage the cost of raw materials.
- New option to [b]keep previously unlocked parts when starting a new game[/b].

[b]Help and tips[/b]

- New [b]"tips" box in the end menu[/b] with more than 40 tips (with a button to display the next tip).
- 2 new notes added on the HoloDesk with 16 tips.

[b]Maintenance and repair[/b]

- [b]New "Fixit - CV2007"[/b], a new tool that [b]can perform quick repairs[/b] but only to damaged housings (unusable to new or broken housings).
- [b]New "Fixit Cells"[/b], a new consumable required by the new Fixit tool in order to make repairs (you can perform 2 repairs with one Fixit cell).
- New default location on the toolrest for the Fixit tool.

[b]Environment[/b]

- Update of the start screen
- Update of the gearbox textures
- Update of the DBE textures
- Update of the camshafts textures

[b]Miscellaneous[/b]

- New vibrations when moving the selection box on the maps

[b]Fix[/b]

- Improvement of the gearbox position in the reproducer drawer
- Decrease of the height of the accelerator


We will now focus our efforts on fixing the various bugs that you found then we will get back to our original roadmap with the goal to push a second big update before the end of the month. We also won't forget to release the promised wiki (end of next week).

We hope this first update will meet your expectations.

[b]Have a good game![/b]

notes.title: Hurry up! Sales end in 24 hours!
notes.notes: It's your last chance to buy Far Beyond: A space odyssey for 16.99$!

notes.title: What we plan for the next month?
notes.notes:
First of all, thank you very much for all the positive feedback you showed toward our game. We are genuinely happy to see that this type of experience pleases the VR community.
Don't hesitate to consult the forum if you have questions or are looking for space survival tips.
We also want to thank JMBounce for his generous support towards the newcomers.

Let's get to the heart of the matter. We want to tell you the direction that will take the development of Far Beyond for the next month.

[b] Here's what we have planned:

- New awesome feature (hint: fire and electricity)
- New tools
- Improvements of the balancing / difficulty
- Display of tips in the menus
- Ranking system (online community?)
- Publication of a wiki [/b] 

First we will focus on balancing the difficulty in order to give you an update next week.

I would like to remind you that Far Beyond: A space odyssey IS NOT an early-access game. But we still want to keep it up to date and improve our game a bit more so you can enjoy an always deeper and immersive game.

Have a good game!

Mains Digitales Interactive team
